'''2020 TMW Pods Jeff Lavigne DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeff Lavigne]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Jeff Lavigne]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
